title: Hitachi Vantara Expands VSP One for Enterprise AI with New Object Storage and Data Lakehouse Capabilities
headline: Hitachi Vantara Expands Data Platform with Governed AI and Storage Capabilities
summary: Hitachi Vantara has announced updates to its VSP One data platform and Hitachi iQ portfolio, introducing object storage enhancements, data lakehouse analytics capabilities, and expanded governed access for retrieval-augmented generation. The new capabilities include Model Gateway for governed model access and role-based access control, designed to help organisations move AI projects from experimentation to production with greater control.
why_it_matters: Expanding governed access to structured and unstructured enterprise data for AI applications helps organisations maintain compliance and security when deploying retrieval-augmented generation and agentic workflows.

quotes.text: Together, the updates connect scalable data infrastructure, in-place analytics and governed AI software to help organisations move from trusted enterprise data to production AI with greater control.

Adds Model Gateway for governed access to local and external models, governed Model Context Protocol (MCP) connectivity and ServiceNow support, along with role-based access, observability and lifecycle management for enterprise AI applications and agents.

classification.significance_reason: Vendor product update introducing infrastructure and governance features for enterprise AI deployments, representing standard industry tooling rather than a regulatory or legal change.
